# Harrison

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P20](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0020)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P12](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0012), [v4 c3 P1](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008), [v2 c18 P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** A crank  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>; Crusty, lonesome, crabbed old chap  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is a short, fat man with prominent blue eyes and a round face. He is bald except for a little fringe of hair around his ears, about which he is very sensitive, though he later keeps what little hair he has carefully trimmed. He wears working clothes that he at times mends himself.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c1 P22](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0022), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

## Personality

Mr. Harrison is an outspoken, crusty, and opinionated individual who prided himself on plainly telling the truth. Although considered irritable, quick-tempered, and eccentric by neighbors, he possesses a soft side and appreciates young company like Anne Shirley. He can be set in his ways and stubborn about his views, yet he shows capacity for warmth, remorse, and hospitality once known better.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)_

- Maintain a quiet life on his Avonlea farm  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P42](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0042)</sub>

## History

In early April, Mr. Harrison bought Robert Bell's farm adjoining Green Gables in Avonlea, quickly earning a reputation as an eccentric bachelor and a crank. He initially clashed with his neighbor Anne Shirley after his Jersey cow repeatedly broke into her oatfield. After Anne accidentally sold his cow mistaking it for her own, she brought him a cake to apologize, leading to a surprising tea and the beginning of a close friendship between them. He lived alone with an ill-tempered, swearing parrot named Ginger, who was later killed when lightning struck the house flue during a storm. Following rumors of a new citizen marrying in Avonlea, his estranged wife Emily arrived and reconciled with him, turning his untidy household into a spotless home. He later offered feedback on Anne's short story and continued to support her through her time at college.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c2 P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 c2 P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042), [v2 c3 P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c24 P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041), [v2 c24 P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 c25 P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v3 c12 P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039), [v3 c12 P74](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0074)_

## Background by volume

- Moved to Avonlea from New Brunswick after buying Robert Bell's farm  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Separated from his wife Emily prior to moving to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 c25 P54](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0054)</sub>
- Obtained a parrot named Ginger from his sailor brother  <sub>[v2 c3 P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m a crusty, lonesome, crabbed old chap, but there’s something about that little girl makes me feel young again . . . and it’s such a pleasant sensation I’d like to have it repeated once in a while.  <sub>[v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049)</sub>

> I’m not going to put up with this, not a day longer, do you hear, miss. Bless my soul, this is the third time, miss . . . the third time!  <sub>[v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013)</sub>

> Tut, tut, don’t say another word about it, miss. It’s of no consequence . . . no consequence whatever. Accidents will happen.  <sub>[v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023)</sub>

> So I do . . . so I do . . . but my approval doesn’t go as deep as my pocket, Anne.  <sub>[v2 c6 P59](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0059)</sub>

> Changes ain’t totally pleasant but they’re excellent things. Two years is about long enough for things to stay exactly the same.  <sub>[v2 c30 P1](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0001)</sub>
